are written in every arm, and every game ends in death or at the cap. Everything is directional; a claim needs a
fresh seed block (RULES 14). Primary measures, fixed here: (1) stocked: the share of town departures after the first
that carry no Word of Recall, and that carry 5 or fewer Phase Doors, per class; (2) situations covered at
departure: of Detect Invisible, Remove Curse, a poison cure, a confusion cure and a fear cure, how many the pack
holds at least one of, per visit after the first; (3) deaths by cause (poison, invisible attackers, curses,
running out of escapes or healing) with rescued and newly killed pairs against ctl; (4) mean max CL and depth,
and alive at the cap.
